label: sec:alpha-k-procedure-atom-knot-mass-preamble
html: Extending the \alpha_k derivation to composite nuclei requires coupling the per-level linear programs across adjacent strand counts A \to A+1. This section formulates the joint-tower semidefinite program (SDP) for multi-level confinement and proves the closed-form Wenzl bridge formula for the canonical Wedderburn weights y_\lambda(q). It then establishes the H_{3A} Wedderburn refinement of the categorical binding density \rho_K, evaluates the staircase-partition closed form for the shell correction \sigma_{\mathrm{shell}} (establishing its exact vanishing on three-row partitions at the Markov parameter z = q^3/(q^2+1)), and identifies the Hopf-to-trefoil nucleon-addition transition at A = 3 \to 4.
